_comment: Event names, the triggers.md headings that mean them, and how each event behaves. Read by the loader at runtime and by D:/SFMod/Tools/AdaPacks/adapack.py when building. Priority 90 and up interrupts a playing line; cooldown is seconds before the event may fire again; chance is 0..1. A pack can override an event with an "events" entry in its pack.json. No voice line text belongs here.

fall_death.description: The player dies from a fall; plays instead of death if it has a line, else death plays.

power_failure.description: A power circuit trips its fuse (single-player or the host).

production_stall.description: Most factories (60% or more of at least 10) are idle or blocked for a full minute (single-player or the host).

building_placed.description: The player or a friend finishes building something.

building_dismantled.description: A demolition: 4 or more buildings dismantled within 10 seconds.

doggo_kill.description: The player kills a Lizard Doggo.

research_complete.description: A MAM research is finished and collected.

research_skip.description: A second MAM research is collected within a minute of the first (research overload).

space_elevator.description: A Space Elevator phase is delivered.

hard_drive.description: A hard drive research is collected.

hostile_zone.description: The player comes within 60 m of an enemy.

idle.description: The player is idle for 10 minutes (use idle:<seconds> in a CSV events cell for another length).

world_loaded.description: The player resumes a saved game (20 seconds after loading).

item_discard.description: The player puts something in the trash slot.

general_status.description: Never fires by itself; only /adapack trigger general_status or a random timer.

session_resume.description: The player returns to the game after 2 or more minutes in the background.

creature_death.description: The player dies to a creature; plays instead of death if it has a line, else death plays.

hazard_death.description: The player dies to an environmental hazard (radiation, gas, fire, drowning); falls back to death like creature_death.

power_restored.description: A tripped power fuse is reset.

production_building_placed.description: A production building (a machine) is finished; falls back to building_placed if it has no line.

random.description: A periodic ping at random times; write random:<seconds> for the average gap (very low frequency recommended).
